limitations: Seven entries have named-scenario qualification, not every export or owning-element feature.
Admission priority does not own DOM order, timeouts, announcements, focus, swipe gestures or persistence; the example supplies those policies where exercised.
The existing swatch suite intentionally skips its detailed forced-color sample assertion in Firefox/WebKit;25 passes do not include those two cases.
Physical touch/IME, native AT speech, retail browsers, other OS/device conditions, full SSR/hydration and separate-owner acceptance remain open.
The other37 of110 public inventory entries remain pending. Historical external CSS-authoring rerun is retired, never passed.
